algorithm.title: Clinical trial design and control group validity

nodes.text: Evaluate clinical trial design: assess control group selection and allocation methodology
**Randomized contemporaneous control group:** gold standard; minimizes selection bias and temporal confounding
**Noncontemporaneous (historical) controls:** vulnerable to secular trends, diagnostic shifts, and improved supportive care
Prefer prospective double-blind randomized controlled trials to establish therapeutic efficacy
Adjust for baseline covariate imbalances when observational designs are unavoidable

algorithm.title: Clinical trial outcome measures and surrogate endpoints

nodes.text: Distinguish patient-important clinical outcomes from intermediate surrogate endpoints
**True clinical endpoints:** mortality, hospitalization, functional capacity, and quality of life
**Surrogate endpoints (e.g., FEV1, blood pressure):** physiological or laboratory biomarkers substituting for clinical outcomes
Acknowledge surrogate limitation: biomarker improvement does not guarantee reduction in clinical events
Design phase 3 confirmatory trials powered directly for primary patient-centered clinical endpoints

nodes.text: Calculate Wells score for deep venous thrombosis (DVT)

**Contraindication to anticoagulation:** place retrievable IVC filter
